title: jig project config
description: .jig/config.jsonc (in git) and .jig/config.local.jsonc (outside git, laid over it: objects merge by key, checks by name, other values replace). jig reads only these files; nothing outside them runs.

rules.description: jig's own rules. Suppression directives are always denied; these levels set the gates for new comments and new test cases (default error for both).

agent-view.description: Proof of UI changes in the running app, read by jig pre-mr

checks.description: The project's own checks, run after an edit or at the end of a turn on the matching files.

name.description: Unique; findings use the rule check/<name>

files.description: Glob or globs, repo-relative with forward slashes

run.description: Command without a shell; the token {files} becomes one argument per file

format.description: exit: a non-zero exit is one finding; jsonl: jig finding lines; a tool name: that tool's output parser

slotEnv.description: Writes the slot number itself into an env file, for a dev script that derives its ports from it

seedExclude.description: Globs (repo-relative, forward slashes) that jig worktree seed skips

copyFiles.description: Files inside fully ignored folders that jig worktree seed copies as well

depsPool.description: Present: jig slot new and jig slot show fill node_modules (npm, yarn) as a hardlink copy of a pool entry keyed by the lock file instead of installing; the first worktree with a lock file installs and fills the entry

after.description: Command run in the worktree after a reuse, for what the install also makes outside node_modules (a postinstall build)

reviewCycle.description: jig review-cycle: the team's review process and the forge. Usually in .jig/config.local.jsonc, since the queue is per reviewer.

processAdapter.description: Executable answering queue, rules, spec, base-check and transition (skills/jig/references/process-adapter.md). Relative to the project root; ~/ is the home directory. .mjs/.js/.cjs run with node, .sh with bash (Git Bash on Windows), .ps1 with PowerShell. Absent: the forge's open merge requests where you are a reviewer, no tracker transitions.

forge.description: Overrides detection by the origin remote (github in the host → github, otherwise gitlab)

ui.description: The project's UI profile for jig ui: what to prove (targets, widths, themes, locales) and which components to reuse.

targets.description: Where the UI runs. Names are unique.

widths.description: Viewport widths in CSS px; required unless the runtime is native. A width below minWidth is an error.

minWidth.description: The narrowest window the app allows

proof.description: native targets are always manual; auto on a native target is an error

themes.description: Names are unique; every entry needs a switch when the list has more than one.

list.description: Longest texts first: the first one is the one proven when the check is one. A locale switches through act or launch only.

check.description: one: only the first listed locale is proven unless the task touches texts

dirs.description: Where the shared components live; raw elements there are fine

files.description: Glob or globs of the files jig ui reuse reads

map.description: Raw element (tag) to the component to use instead, e.g. "button": "Button (@/shared/ui/buttons)"

tokens.description: Files or folders with the design tokens (CSS custom properties); the default of jig ui mockup --tokens

switch.description: Exactly one: media (an emulated prefers-color-scheme value), act (an agent-view use case), launch (a string the flow passes to the app launch). A locale takes act or launch only.

timeout.description: Seconds it may run at the end of a turn; every end-of-turn check shares 110 s. A run that does not finish leaves the result unknown and blocks the turn once.

tool.description: A catalog tool or proof by name. {} turns it on, false turns it off; a name missing from the config never runs.

command.description: Replaces the catalog command, e.g. vue-tsc for tsc

ignoreRules.description: Rule globs whose findings are dropped, e.g. boundaries/*

timeout.description: Seconds the tool may run at the end of a turn; default eslint 30 plus 1 per file, tsc 60, stratum 15
